title: Bitter About My Hot Friend
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all ingredients to a mixing tin with ice. Shake and double strain over fresh ice into a chilled  glass. Garnish.
Habanero TinctureWith latex gloves on, de-stem and chop 4 habaneros. Add the chopped chiles to 1 bottle of vodka and allow to macerate for 2 weeks. Strain in a bottle.
